runner_change: Only the optional exact pub(super) prefix in region(); generic support and ownership checks unchanged from basis.
legacy_probe: nix/oracle-legacy-probe.sh remains unchanged and is still run by the original generated app

helper_copies.scope: Modern native 11G fixture only; both fixture users inherit the existing generated and masked ORACLE_PASSWORD. Original legacy probe and nix/oracle-login-fixtures.sh remain unchanged.

helper_copies.callback: modern native only; unchanged legacy probe has no callback

bootstrap: The unchanged runner causality-app bootstrap supplies nextest, required Postgres/ClickHouse tiers and drivers; modern Oracle port and admin credentials remain inherited.
regular_task: Canonical just test-only discovery and whole affected binaries, ci Cargo profile, nofailfast nextest profile; no ignored-cell wrapper.
required_retention: all original native and legacy baseline logs
limits: No source-only check proves a native fixture, million-row census, intended kill, or full restored binary pass.
Runner own_sites admits any panic in the named owner; acceptance also requires the exact intended assertion and mismatch in declared-text-ownership.json.
One callback per fresh hosted job; fixed output directory is never reused.
Scalar admission removal may fail the plain query first; only unmutated head/restored run the later UPPER branch.
No legacy-only application fixture or new workflow/task/framework is introduced.
